request.body:
Backroad Rally · 乡野拉力 0.1.0 的 pureTV 手柄 macOS 通用版预发布，提供原始 DMG 与 ZIP。

要求 macOS 11+、WebGL2，包含 arm64 与 x86_64，支持 pureTV 九键手柄、默认 TCP 63485、真实连接 ID、断线取消与手动恢复。两个文件超过 GitHub 单文件 100 MiB 限制，放在此 Release。

原包复验44615672670中，Apple Silicon原生、端口占用和Rosetta各9项通过。后续同包44617061184中，端口占用和Rosetta仍各9项通过，原生前8项通过，最后存档重启检查在系统通知占据前台时超时；新本地地址及4个存档值一致，但后续断言未完成。原失败记录保留。Intel Mac图形运行未验证，未经过Apple公证，未做实体手柄或完整通关测试。

原构建源68d343d22c762c904eb83854d4ab9c4113a7c30f / 流程44608415225；文件未重建或重签。Android和Windows继续验证，暂不包含在本次下载中。完整说明与校验记录：https://github.com/ecojust/pureTV/tree/master/joystick-games/backroad-rally

resolvedFinding.resolution: Now resolves from game root to exactly the same original runtime-findings.json as the four-level verification.json link; both files exist.

reviewNotes: Five prepared files and exact publish request are mutually consistent. Stable public tag URLs are intended for after publication; original draft API URLs are temporary untagged URLs. This review did not claim public GET success before publication.

Both original release asset IDs/bytes/SHA match the successfully preserved immutable transfer receipt and direct asset API records. Each exceeds 100 MiB. Original source 68d/run44608415225 and unchanged bytes are distinct from later QA-only sources. No 205 MiB-scale re-download or package reconstruction occurred.

V1 c19/44615672670 has original native/occupied/Rosetta nine-check passes. V2 e7/44617061184 preserves native eight passes followed by a failed final restart foreground gate, with UserNotificationCenter frontmost; occupied/Rosetta retain nine passes. Four stored value hashes agree before/initial/current and origin changed, but remaining restart assertions were not executed and the failure is not reclassified.

Root README, metadata and release body state the later failure/incomplete check and Intel graphics unverified, ad-hoc/no Apple notarization, no physical controller/full completion, and Android/Windows pending. The original classifier and reports remain unchanged.
Publish request is limited to draft=false, prerelease=true, make_latest=false and the reviewed body for the already existing release. This reviewer did not execute it.
